lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa piaare teree amar rajaai ||7||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You is good, O Beloved; Your Will is Eternal. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ra(n)g rate naaraainai piaare maate sahaj subhaai ||8||2||4||
lines.translation: Nanak, those who are imbued with the Love of the All-Pervading Lord, O Beloved, remain intoxicated with His Love, in natural ease. ||8||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh bidh tum hee jaanate piaare kis pahi kahau sunaai ||1||
lines.translation: You know all about my condition, O Beloved; who can I speak to about it? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) daataa jeeaa sabhanaa kaa teraa ditaa pahirahi khaai ||2||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of all beings; they eat and wear what You give them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh teree aagiaa piaare doojee naahee jaai ||3||
lines.translation: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will, O Beloved; they do not come from any other. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo too(n) karaavahi so karee piaare avar kichh karan na jaai ||4||
lines.translation: Whatever You cause me to do, that I do, O Beloved; I cannot do anything else. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: din rain sabh suhaavane piaare jit japeeai har naau ||5||
lines.translation: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee piaare dhur masatak lekh likhaai ||6||
lines.translation: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: eko aap varatadaa piaare ghat ghat rahiaa samaai ||7||
lines.translation: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each and every heart. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੨॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar koop te udhar lai piaare naanak har saranaai ||8||3||22||15||2||42||
lines.translation: Lift me up out of the deep pit of the world, O Beloved; Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary. ||8||3||22||15||2||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਟੀ ਲਿਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 patee likhee ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Patee Likhee ~ The Poem Of The Alphabet:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸੈ ਸੋਇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasai soi srisat jin saajee sabhanaa saahib ek bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Sassa: He who created the world, is the One Lord and Master of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sevat rahe chit jinh kaa laagaa aaiaa tinh kaa saphal bhaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Those whose consciousness remains committed to His Service - blessed is their birth and their coming into the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kaahe bhoole mooR manaa ||
lines.translation: O mind, why forget Him? You foolish mind!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬੀਰਾ ਤਉ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lekhaa devahi beeraa tau paRiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When your account is adjusted, O brother, only then shall you be judged wise. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਵੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eevaRee aad purakh hai daataa aape sachaa soee ||
lines.translation: Eevree: The Primal Lord is the Giver; He alone is True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਨਾ ਅਖਰਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: enaa akharaa mahi jo guramukh boojhai tis sir lekh na hoee ||2||
lines.translation: No accounting is due from the Gurmukh who understands the Lord through these letters. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊੜੈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooRai upamaa taa kee keejai jaa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Ooraa: Sing the Praises of the One whose limit cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa karahi seee phal paavahi jinhee sach kamaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Those who perform service and practice truth, obtain the fruits of their rewards. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਙੰਙੈ ਙਿਆਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nga(n)ngai ngiaan boojhai je koee paRiaa pa(n)dit soee ||
lines.translation: Nganga: One who understands spiritual wisdom becomes a Pandit, a religious scholar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jeeaa mahi eko jaanai taa haumai kahai na koee ||4||
lines.translation: One who recognizes the One Lord among all beings does not talk of ego. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਕੈ ਕੇਸ ਪੁੰਡਰ ਜਬ ਹੂਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਬੂਣੈ ਉਜਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kakai kes pu(n)dar jab hooe vin saaboonai ujaliaa ||
lines.translation: Kakka: When the hair grows grey, then it shines without shampoo.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੇ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jam raaje ke heroo aae maaiaa kai sa(n)gal ba(n)dh laiaa ||5||
lines.translation: The hunters of the King of Death come, and bind him in the chains of Maya. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਖੈ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਹ ਆਲਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਰੀਦਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: khakhai khu(n)dakaar saah aalam kar khareed jin kharach deeaa ||
lines.translation: Khakha: The Creator is the King of the world; He enslaves by giving nourishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan jaa kai sabh jag baadhiaa avaree kaa nahee hukam paiaa ||6||
lines.translation: By His Binding, all the world is bound; no other Command prevails. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਇ ਗਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਗਲੀ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gagai goi gaai jin chhodee galee gobid garab bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Gagga: One who renounces the singing of the songs of the Lord of the Universe, becomes arrogant in his speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਵੀ ਸਾਜੀ ਚਾੜਣ ਵਾਹੈ ਤਈ ਕੀਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ghaR bhaa(n)de jin aavee saajee chaaRan vaahai taee keeaa ||7||
lines.translation: One who has shaped the pots, and made the world the kiln, decides when to put them in it. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਘੈ ਘਾਲ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਘਾਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaghai ghaal sevak je ghaalai sabad guroo kai laag rahai ||
lines.translation: Ghagha: The servant who performs service, remains attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa je sam kar jaanai in bidh saahib ramat rahai ||8||
lines.translation: One who recognizes bad and good as one and the same - in this way he is absorbed into the Lord and Master. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਚੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chachai chaar ved jin saaje chaare khaanee chaar jugaa ||
lines.translation: Chacha: He created the four Vedas, the four sources of creation, and the four ages

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਾਣੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug jogee khaanee bhogee paRiaa pa(n)dit aap theeaa ||9||
lines.translation: - through each and every age, He Himself has been the Yogi, the enjoyer, the Pandit and the scholar. ||9||
